title: Tell Huckstash about Hep

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: So. You found your way back to the underworld.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So. You found your way back to the underworld.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I’m the ferryman. Cross my palm with Lims and I’ll take you to the other side.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m the ferryman. Cross my palm with Lims and I’ll take you to the other side.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: A lost city. The one we can’t go back to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A lost city. The one we can’t go back to.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Don’t listen to me, kid. I've been on the Joos. It's the LUZ, its getting to me. Like my skin’s too tight for my bones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don’t listen to me, kid. I've been on the Joos. It's the LUZ, its getting to me. Like my skin’s too tight for my bones.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I got answers. Maybe not the ones you want…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got answers. Maybe not the ones you want…

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Where the fuck did you get that name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where the fuck did you get that name?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Hmm. Just when I think I got you figured.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm. Just when I think I got you figured.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You better start spilling details.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You better start spilling details.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Agent Gimble was the most bloodthirsty erasure technician ever lived. Killed thousands. So. Where is she?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Agent Gimble was the most bloodthirsty erasure technician ever lived. Killed thousands. So. Where is she?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: What's that to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's that to you?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I might. I might also hope you'd just fucking tell me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I might. I might also hope you'd just fucking tell me.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: She was the most bloodthirsty erasure technician ever lived. Killed thousands. You're damn right she should answer. So. Where is she?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was the most bloodthirsty erasure technician ever lived. Killed thousands. You're damn right she should answer. So. Where is she?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Fucking leech. Fine. Here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking leech. Fine. Here.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: The gardens, huh. Interesting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The gardens, huh. Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I will warn her to not tell naive kids about her past.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will warn her to not tell naive kids about her past.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Knew you'd do the right thing, kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Knew you'd do the right thing, kid.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Fucking oogle. You've got no idea what you're talking about. Get out of here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fucking oogle. You've got no idea what you're talking about. Get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I have all the information I need.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have all the information I need.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: She's still needed. Ask Thaddeus about it - if he lets you. His words were always "She's still needed."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's still needed. Ask Thaddeus about it - if he lets you. His words were always "She's still needed."

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Yes. And so should you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. And so should you!

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You little worm. You've got no idea who you're talking to. Get out of my sight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You little worm. You've got no idea who you're talking to. Get out of my sight.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If this is the underworld, then what are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If this is the underworld, then what are you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If this is the underworld, then what are you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If this is the underworld, then what are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: To where?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To where?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a question...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a question...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Have you ever heard of Hepzibah Gimble?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Heard it somewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heard it somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Elias Malt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Elias Malt.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why? What will you do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why? What will you do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He said you might pay good money to know where she is...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He said you might pay good money to know where she is...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He said you might pay good money to know where she is...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He said you might pay good money to know where she is...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Elias said she killed people. She should answer for that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Elias said she killed people. She should answer for that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Elias said she killed people. She should answer for that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Elias said she killed people. She should answer for that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's just an old woman who doesn't remember anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's just an old woman who doesn't remember anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's just an old woman who doesn't remember anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's just an old woman who doesn't remember anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's in Skyhigh Gardens.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's in Skyhigh Gardens.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll tell you. For 500 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell you. For 500 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you should leave her alone. Let it go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you should leave her alone. Let it go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you should leave her alone. Let it go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you should leave her alone. Let it go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's in Skyhigh Gardens.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's in Skyhigh Gardens.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why should I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why should I?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have some information you want.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some information you want.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have some information you want.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have some information you want.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you just said...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You just do what Thaddeus' tells you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You just do what Thaddeus' tells you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You just do what Thaddeus' tells you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You just do what Thaddeus' tells you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Please don't kill her!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please don't kill her!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A warning, though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A warning, though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My informant looked like he wanted you to kill her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My informant looked like he wanted you to kill her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: My informant looked like he wanted you to kill her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: My informant looked like he wanted you to kill her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright.
